audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Lillia five of seven stages while every why line under it says Darius wins — whys[0] 'Darius owns level 1 outright', whys[1] 'he still wins level 2', whys[3] 'he keeps the edge', whys[4] 'your delayed sleep can't out-burst his level-6 all-in'. tldr called Darius 'a treadmill victim' and breakdown.difficulty called this a favoured matchup at 4/10 while diff already said HARD.
audit.why: I read the mirror's actual edits rather than its summary: darius__lillia.json sets phases[0..5].side to Darius and phases[6] to Lillia, with ratings 8, 8, 8.5, 8, 8, 7, 3.5. My rows must be the same sides and the inverse ratings, or mirror-fix overwrites one side of the pair.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 flipped to Darius in matched full/content pairs; row 6 stays Lillia. Ratings set to the exact inverse of the mirror: 2, 2, 1.5, 2, 2, 3, 6.5. Note this makes row 5 Darius rather than the packet's Skill — the mirror is already committed there and the two pages must agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and first item were listed as your spikes; both are his, and the only real Lillia spike is two items.
audit.why: Noxian Guillotine is true damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks and REFRESHES on a kill, so a low-HP kite is not a survival plan at 6. Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 — that number, not a vague 'bait the pull', is what makes first item survivable.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why states the reset and true damage; phases[1].why and phases[5].why carry Apprehend's 26s; phases[6].why states the two-item takeover.

audit.whatIsWrong: Decimate is never named, and the page treats Apprehend purely as a pull without stating what makes it lethal.
audit.why: Apprehend also passively gives Darius armour penetration, and Decimate heals him off every champion hit with the blade — so a long trade refills him while your Dream Dust ticks. Grievous Wounds has a real target here, which report[8] half-says. NOTE: the kit flags Apprehend as 'knockup'; Riot's text says it sweeps enemies up with a hook and PULLS them, so I made no knockup claim — the same call the mirror made.
audit.corrected: Decimate and the bleed-stacked heal named in phases[2].why and phases[3].why.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags 'His Noxian Guillotine' and 'Reset Noxian Guillotine' as probable wrong names. Both are FALSE POSITIVES — Noxian Guillotine is the correct name of Darius's R. No change made.
